scope: V2.4 A CPU / B partial CUDA / C complete RGB8 CUDA; freeze before implementing and measuring C
reference: CPU float32 division before half-pixel bilinear; centered zero RGB padding, then normalization; FP32 NCHW I/O
selection: Correctness and frozen quality gates first; compare SDK/replay P99, success and rejection, allocation and memory costs. C and two slots need not be faster. Hold the model/precision constant during A/B/C comparison.
resources: Each slot owns its stream/events, context, FP32 I/O and mode-specific scratch/pinned buffers. RGB8 capacity follows original pixel limit. No steady-state cudaMalloc/cudaHostAlloc with buffer reuse enabled. Pending and ready results retain admission reservations until get or safe abandonment.
provenance: 2026-10-11 V2 samples and quality thresholds are reused as regression data, not claimed to be newly unseen holdouts. Historical timings remain separately labelled.
